name: PBQniversity of Alabama 2026
information:
**Note:** Competitors under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian at all times.

Free parking is available [in the surface lot across the street from the venue](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Parking+lot,+230+7th+Ave,+Tuscaloosa,+AL+35401/@33.2151749,-87.5464953,550m/data=!3m2!1e3!5s0x888602a236366c3b:0x644757bd8c8ef43e!4m6!3m5!1s0x888602a3c2917b95:0xf8742e2669de684f!8m2!3d33.2161395!4d-87.5452851!16s%2Fg%2F11bw43bbfq?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDEyMS4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=a2fd7e3f-9505-4785-b768-786a142d32fd).

![southeastcubing.org](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDI1NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9de1c0ebe62c6dc55566d579b73b3e7217ed5110/SOUTHEAST_5.png)
This competition is organized by Alabama Crimson Cubing, the University of Alabama's cubing club, and is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQniversityofAlabama2026#70780-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
